During Chapter 18, apply pipeline-v1.yaml and inspect its status.scanExitCode (1). Then apply attestation-v2.yaml and pipeline-v2.yaml: the repaired release signs. Restore the chapter attestation.yaml before verifying the original release handover.

The images and CVE associations are authored teaching assets. No registries or remote services are contacted. Native command syntax is retained; real environments need their own endpoint, credentials and permissions.
